name: puedes
description: PUEDES? - Jogo web multiplayer de dedução social em tempo real

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
